title: Emily Dickinson Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Advance tickets are now available through October! Make your plans to visit the place she called home and be among the first visitors of 2026. The Emily Dickinson Museum is open to visitors March through December. Begin your visit at the Museum’s Tour Center, located in the carriage house (220 Main St, Amherst), to check-in for an existing reservation or to purchase tour tickets. From there, visit our Museum shop, grounds, and gardens, all of which are open to the public. Last entry to the Museum is at 4PM. Purchasing tickets online ahead of your visit is recommended. Tickets: Prices include visits to both houses - visitors reserve consecutive timed entry to the Homestead. Massachusetts

services.name: Studio Sessions
services.desc: “Sweet hours have perished here; This is a mighty room; Within its precincts hopes have played, - Now shadows in the tomb.” -Fr1785 Spend a “sweet hour” in Emily Dickinson’s creative space where she penned her startling poetry and honed her revolutionary voice. Whether you are a writer, an artist, a composer, a poet, or a lover of poetry, you’ll find inspiration in Emily Dickinson’s own room. Let this quiet experience jumpstart your next creative journey. Participants may reserve up to two hours in the room. A small table and chair will be provided.
